title: Anomaly — the cold halo
notes: ION anomaly. Deliberately NOT a violet wash: earlier review threw that out and the profile
still says so. What replaces it is a single large STRUCTURE — the far shell of an old blast,
two arcs at different radii and angles so the shell reads as a curved surface with thickness
rather than a drawn ring, plus one dense knot where the shell is brightest.
The right half of the frame carries a second protected void because the anomaly profile spawns
a live wormhole there; the sky must not be behind it. Corridor void as everywhere else.

layers.comment: The shell's interior, barely there: it tells the eye the arcs enclose something.
Outer shell. Both ends dissolve through the taper — no shared straight cut-off.
Inner shell at a different radius and sweep: two surfaces make a volume, one makes a ring.
The bright knot where the shell piles up — the landmark you steer by.
Cold dust drawn across the shell's lower limb, so the shell has a near and a far side.
Wormhole headroom: the anomaly profile spawns one here, and it must own its patch of sky.
